Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
Sl. Office Notes,
No. Date reports,
 orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order
S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  Delay Condonation Appl. No. 1 of 2026  Bail Appl. No. 2 of 2026  In  CRLR No. 102 of 2026  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. S.C. Burman, learned counsel with Mr. Chandra Shekhar, learned counsel for the revisionist.
2. Mr. B.C. Joshi, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. The present criminal revision has been preferred by the revisionist (convict) Virendra Bharti, S/o Ramkaran Bharti against his conviction for the offence punishable under Section 498A IPC whereby he has been awarded two years rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs. 1000/- and in default of payment of fine he has to undergo further one month's additional imprisonment.
4. As per the office report, there is a delay of 1679 days.

5. Issue notice to respondent no. 2 on delay condonation application.
6.

7. The bail application (IA No. 2 of 2026) has also been moved along with the custody certificate which is annexed at page 48 and as per the custody certificate dated 04.02.2026 issued by the Jailor, District Jail Haldwani the revisionist has already served five months and nine days in custody.
8.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the revisionist that father of the revisionist is seriously ill, therefore, taking into consideration that maximum sentence as awarded is 2 years and almost more than five months the revisionist has served, the revisionist be released on bail.
9. Learned State Counsel has no objection.

CRLR/102/2026 on 27 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15549863/
1 10.
In such view of the matter, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, the bail application is allowed.

11. Let the revisionist (convict) be released on bail, during the pendency of the instant revision, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
12. List this revision for admission in the week commencing 06.04.2026.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 27.02.2026 Parul CRLR/102/2026 on 27 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15549863/
